summary.text: Carey Hamilton is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 87 who has represented the district since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously worked for the Indiana Department of Environmental Management and led the Indiana Recycling Coalition.

paragraphs.text: Hamilton graduated from Pike High School in Indianapolis and holds a bachelor's degree from Indiana University-Bloomington.

Early in her career she was a program manager for the Indiana Department of Environmental Management and the first leader of Indiana's Greening the Government Program, and she later served as executive director of the Indiana Recycling Coalition.
She took office in the Indiana House on November 9, 2016, succeeding Christina Hale.
